notes: All backgrounds are 1280x896 RGB PNG and quantized to 255 colours.
All portrait frames are 512x768 RGB PNG and quantized to 15 colours.
All keyed sprites use exact #FF00FF backing and a 16-entry total palette.
Portrait animation is intentionally micro-motion/light drift derived from the supplied card art.
B4, B6 and B7 are style-matched variants derived from the supplied background references.
